on035:i00180","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:137d504c6d5d4ca4ea9af8d7","title":"三萬","alt":"三"}],"tableContext":null},{"id":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0097","type":"text","tag":"p","paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0034","text":"染め色の面子候補は揃っており満貫が見込める。トイトイ白中の満貫もみて","segments":[{"text":"染め色の面子候補は揃っており満貫が見込める。トイトイ白中の満貫もみて","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"id":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0098","type":"image-run","paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0034","images":[{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00181","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:cf903c27e3d6d79024397f25","title":"二萬","alt":"二"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00182","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:fa4ca8dbce129a7a05fc2fa8","title":"三萬","alt":"三"}],"tableContext":null},{"id":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0099","type":"text","tag":"p","paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0034","text":"落しが有力か。巡目が深くなって手が伸びなければ1,000点や2,000点の手に終わってしまうこともままあるがそれはそれでよい。巡目や他家の進行状況を顧みずに無理染めに固執することは避けたい。","segments":[{"text":"落しが有力か。巡目が深くなって手が伸びなければ1,000点や2,000点の手に終わってしまうこともままあるがそれはそれでよい。巡目や他家の進行状況を顧みずに無理染めに固執することは避けたい。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"id":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0100","type":"text","tag":"p","paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0035","text":"一色手は強力な手役だが相手に狙いを読まれやすいというデメリットがある。しかしこれについてはあまり気にしなくて良い。警戒されずに高い手を和了できるより良い手順が他にあることは滅多に無く、手が悪い時に染め手を狙って相手に警戒させるのは寧ろメリットになりうるからである。但し、既に面子候補が足りていて染め色や字牌でも不要な孤立牌が出てくる場合もある。このような牌は先に切り出して染め手を狙っていることをカモフラージュするのが有効である。また、ホンイツに決め打ちする場合、二番目に多い色から切っていく方がどの色で染めているかが相手に判るまで時間がかかる分若干仕掛けやすくなるというメリットが一応ある。","segments":[{"text":"一色手は強力な手役だが相手に狙いを読まれやすいというデメリットがある。しかしこれについてはあまり気にしなくて良い。警戒されずに高い手を和了できるより良い手順が他にあることは滅多に無く、手が悪い時に染め手を狙って相手に警戒させるのは寧ろメリットになりうるからである。但し、既に面子候補が足りていて染め色や字牌でも不要な孤立牌が出てくる場合もある。このような牌は先に切り出して染め手を狙っていることをカモフラージュするのが有効である。また、ホンイツに決め打ちする場合、二番目に多い色から切っていく方がどの色で染めているかが相手に判るまで時間がかかる分若干仕掛けやすくなるというメリットが一応ある。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"id":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0101","type":"text","tag":"p","paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0036","text":"例：","segments":[{"text":"例：","marks":["span::bold"],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"id":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0102","type":"image-run","paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0036","images":[{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00183","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:c2e1bc47e16951c65ef2acaa","title":"六萬","alt":"六"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00184","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:947ac9e4290a3efde47c8a0e","title":"二索","alt":"２"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00185","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:efde650fe35a084958cfb03f","title":"三索","alt":"３"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00186","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:e55f2661c108fb3854242c3f","title":"五索","alt":"５"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00187","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:67422e7f1a2aaedf226710e6","title":"七索","alt":"７"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00188","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:865231b0b04f914254e01fc9","title":"八索","alt":"８"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00189","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:980a15d32d9378aab6e30fb4","title":"東","alt":"東"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00190","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:980a15d32d9378aab6e30fb4","title":"東","alt":"東"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00191","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:980a15d32d9378aab6e30fb4","title":"東","alt":"東"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00192","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:b1129ff7c5cc68acdf0cdd67","title":"西","alt":"西"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00193","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:b1129ff7c5cc68acdf0cdd67","title":"西","alt":"西"}],"tableContext":null},{"id": 「","marks":[],"href":null},{"text":"多面張理論（メンチンの革命編）","marks":[],"href":"http://ameblo.jp/010101/entry-10035459441.html"},{"text":"」の内容を参照されたい。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null}],"tables":[]},"candidate":{"title":"染手（混一色、清一色）","blocks":[{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0001"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0001","text":"染手（混一色、清一色）","sourceSegments":[{"text":"一色手（混一色･清一色）","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0002"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0002","text":"即使副露也有望获得高打点，因此性价比很高，也经常会从离听牌还很远的阶段强行做染手。正因如此，很多局面都难以判断是否应该以染手为目标。这次就尝试为这种难以判断的染手选择，设立尽可能明确的判断标准。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"鳴いても高打点が見込めるのでコストパフォーマンスが良く、テンパイに遠いところから強引に染めていくこともしばしばある。その為、一色手を狙うかどうかの判断が難しい局面も多々ある。今回は、その判断が難しい染め手狙いについて、できるだけ明確な判断基準を設けることを試みる。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0040"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0019","text":"考虑满足条件A、B时的强度","sourceSegments":[{"text":"条件A、Bを満たした場合の強さを考慮する","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0041"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0020","text":"简单来说，就是比较做成染手和做成其他面子手时的打点。如果有2组役牌对子（或1组役牌对子＋仍有剩余的字牌2～3种），或宝牌属于目标花色或字牌，就很容易做成满贯级别的手牌，因此更适合积极地做染手。尤其是有2组役牌对子的手牌，希望尽可能通过混一色、对对和、宝牌等做成满贯级别的手牌。另一方面，如果不做染手也有望达到满贯级别，或其他花色中有宝牌或赤宝牌，就不必勉强保留孤立字牌，以役牌＋α为主线，摸牌顺利时再做染手即可。在选择是否保留孤立役牌时，如果该役牌成对后仍有转向混一色的可能，也就是有可能满足条件A，那么保留役牌就更有利。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"簡単に言えば一色手になった場合と他の面子手になった場合の打点の比較である。役牌トイツが２組（もしくは役牌トイツ１組＋生きている字牌２〜３種）あったり、ドラが染め色や字牌であれば容易に満貫クラスの手になるので尚積極的に染める方が良くなる。特に役牌トイツ２組の手はなるだけホンイツやトイトイ、ドラ等で満貫クラスの手に仕上げたい。一方、染めなくても満貫クラスが見込めるような手や他色にドラや赤がある手であれば無理に孤立字牌を残したりせず、役牌＋αを本線にしつつツモが良ければ染める程度でよい。孤立役牌を残すかどうかを選択する場合も、孤立役牌が重なることでホンイツに移行する可能性が残る、即ち条件Aを満たしうる可能性が出てくるときは尚役牌残しが良くなる。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0042"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0021","text":"西家　第2巡","sourceSegments":[{"text":"西家　２巡目","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0043"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0021","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0043:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0044"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0021","text":"　→切","sourceSegments":[{"text":"　→打","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0045"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0021","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0045:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0046"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0021","text":"或","sourceSegments":[{"text":"か","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0047"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0021","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0047:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0048"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0022","text":"基本上以混一色为目标副露推进。毕竟也有对对和的可能，所以切","sourceSegments":[{"text":"ほぼホンイツで仕掛けていく。一応トイトイもあるので打","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0049"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0022","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0049:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0050"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0022","text":"或切","sourceSegments":[{"text":"か打","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0051"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0022","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0051:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0052"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0022","text":"。大多只能做成仅有混一色这一役的手牌，但其他和牌途径都很困难，所以也没有办法。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"。ほとんどホンイツのみどまりの手になるが、他に和了する方法が難しいのでやむをえない。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0053"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0023","text":"第4巡","sourceSegments":[{"text":"４巡目","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0054"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0023","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0054:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0055"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0023","text":"　→拆掉万子的两嵌","sourceSegments":[{"text":"　→マンズのリャンカン払い","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0056"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0024","text":"筒子或字牌只要形成搭子（对子），就能满足条件A，而且从速度和打点来看，混一色也更有利。现在就先于字牌拆掉万子的两嵌。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"ピンズか字牌でターツ（トイツ）が出来れば条件Aを満たすし、速度や打点面でもホンイツ有利。字牌より先にもうマンズのリャンカンを払っていく。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0057"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0025","text":"第6巡","sourceSegments":[{"text":"６巡目","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0058"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0025","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja s":[{"text":"　→打","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0085"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0031","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0085:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0086"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0032","text":"若只考虑组成面子的难易程度，","sourceSegments":[{"text":"面子構成しやすさだけを考えれば","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0087"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0032","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0087:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0088"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0032","text":"或","sourceSegments":[{"text":"や","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0089"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0032","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0089:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0090"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0032","text":"最不需要，但应保留索子混一色或一气通贯的可能性，切","sourceSegments":[{"text":"が一番不要だが、ソーズのホンイツやイッツー目は残して打","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0091"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0032","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0091:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0092"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0032","text":"。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0093"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0033","text":"第2巡","sourceSegments":[{"text":"２巡目","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0094"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0033","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0094:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0095"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0033","text":"　→切","sourceSegments":[{"text":"　→打","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0096"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0033","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0096:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0097"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0034","text":"目标花色的面子候选已经齐备，有望达到满贯。也考虑到对对和、白、中组成的满贯，","sourceSegments":[{"text":"染め色の面子候補は揃っており満貫が見込める。トイトイ白中の満貫もみて","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0098"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0034","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0098:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0099"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0034","text":"的拆除或许是有力的选择。巡目变深后，如果手牌没有发展，也时常会最终只做成1,000点或2,000点的手牌，但这样也可以。应避免不顾巡目和其他家的进展，执意勉强做染手。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"落しが有力か。巡目が深くなって手が伸びなければ1,000点や2,000点の手に終わってしまうこともままあるがそれはそれでよい。巡目や他家の進行状況を顧みずに無理染めに固執することは避けたい。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0100"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0035","text":"染手是强力的役种，但有容易被对手看穿意图的缺点。不过，这一点不必太在意。因为很少有其他更好的打法能让自己不被警戒地和出高分手牌，而在手牌较差时以染手为目标，让对手产生警戒，反而可能成为优点。不过，也有面子候选已经足够，即使是目标花色或字牌，也会出现不需要的孤立牌的情况。先切出这类牌，掩饰自己正在做染手的意图，是有效的做法。另外，决定专做混一色时，先从数量第二多的花色开始切，能让对手花更长时间才判断出自己在染哪种花色，因此多少也有稍微更容易副露的优点。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"一色手は強力な手役だが相手に狙いを読まれやすいというデメリットがある。しかしこれについてはあまり気にしなくて良い。警戒されずに高い手を和了できるより良い手順が他にあることは滅多に無く、手が悪い時に染め手を狙って相手に警戒させるのは寧ろメリットになりうるからである。但し、既に面子候補が足りていて染め色や字牌でも不要な孤立牌が出てくる場合もある。このような牌は先に切り出して染め手を狙っていることをカモフラージュするのが有効である。また、ホンイツに決め打ちする場合、二番目に多い色から切っていく方がどの色で染めているかが相手に判るまで時間がかかる分若干仕掛けやすくなるというメリットが一応ある。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0101"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0036","text":"**例：**","sourceSegments":[{"text":"例：","marks":["span::bold"],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0102"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0036","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0102:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0103"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0036","text":"　碰","sourceSegments":[{"text":"　ポン","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0104"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0036","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0104:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0105"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0036","text":"　→切","sourceSegments":[{"text":"　→打","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0106"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0036","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0106:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0107"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0037","text":"染手（尤其是门前清的清一色）容易形成多面听。关于快速看出多面听的方法，请参阅[牌效率论20](http://yabejp.web.fc2.com/mahjong/tactics/chapter01/section020.html)中介 :null}],"tableContext":null},{"id":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0042","type":"text","tag":"p","paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0021","text":"西家　２巡目","segments":[{"text":"西家　２巡目","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"id":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0043","type":"image-run","paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0021","images":[{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00063","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:c2e1bc47e16951c65ef2acaa","title":"六萬","alt":"六"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00064","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:51df8a5007948f0751d3d34b","title":"六筒","alt":"(6)"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00065","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:0eab0782a1bb23c7d0cbcef9","title":"九筒","alt":"(9)"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00066","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:0eab0782a1bb23c7d0cbcef9","title":"九筒","alt":"(9)"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00067","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:efde650fe35a084958cfb03f","title":"三索","alt":"３"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00068","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:e55f2661c108fb3854242c3f","title":"五索","alt":"５"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00069","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:e55f2661c108fb3854242c3f","title":"五索","alt":"５"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00070","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:47f82ab50e8c424dc7c0cd42","title":"六索","alt":"６"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00071","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:865231b0b04f914254e01fc9","title":"八索","alt":"８"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00072","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:28ebedfef849bd888ea6d4ca","title":"南","alt":"南"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00073","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:28ebedfef849bd888ea6d4ca","title":"南","alt":"南"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-sect on035:i00180","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:137d504c6d5d4ca4ea9af8d7","title":"三萬","alt":"三"}],"tableContext":null},{"id":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0097","type":"text","tag":"p","paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0034","text":"染め色の面子候補は揃っており満貫が見込める。トイトイ白中の満貫もみて","segments":[{"text":"染め色の面子候補は揃っており満貫が見込める。トイトイ白中の満貫もみて","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"id":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0098","type":"image-run","paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0034","images":[{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00181","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:cf903c27e3d6d79024397f25","title":"二萬","alt":"二"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00182","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:fa4ca8dbce129a7a05fc2fa8","title":"三萬","alt":"三"}],"tableContext":null},{"id":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0099","type":"text","tag":"p","paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0034","text":"落しが有力か。巡目が深くなって手が伸びなければ1,000点や2,000点の手に終わってしまうこともままあるがそれはそれでよい。巡目や他家の進行状況を顧みずに無理染めに固執することは避けたい。","segments":[{"text":"落しが有力か。巡目が深くなって手が伸びなければ1,000点や2,000点の手に終わってしまうこともままあるがそれはそれでよい。巡目や他家の進行状況を顧みずに無理染めに固執することは避けたい。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"id":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0100","type":"text","tag":"p","paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0035","text":"一色手は強力な手役だが相手に狙いを読まれやすいというデメリットがある。しかしこれについてはあまり気にしなくて良い。警戒されずに高い手を和了できるより良い手順が他にあることは滅多に無く、手が悪い時に染め手を狙って相手に警戒させるのは寧ろメリットになりうるからである。但し、既に面子候補が足りていて染め色や字牌でも不要な孤立牌が出てくる場合もある。このような牌は先に切り出して染め手を狙っていることをカモフラージュするのが有効である。また、ホンイツに決め打ちする場合、二番目に多い色から切っていく方がどの色で染めているかが相手に判るまで時間がかかる分若干仕掛けやすくなるというメリットが一応ある。","segments":[{"text":"一色手は強力な手役だが相手に狙いを読まれやすいというデメリットがある。しかしこれについてはあまり気にしなくて良い。警戒されずに高い手を和了できるより良い手順が他にあることは滅多に無く、手が悪い時に染め手を狙って相手に警戒させるのは寧ろメリットになりうるからである。但し、既に面子候補が足りていて染め色や字牌でも不要な孤立牌が出てくる場合もある。このような牌は先に切り出して染め手を狙っていることをカモフラージュするのが有効である。また、ホンイツに決め打ちする場合、二番目に多い色から切っていく方がどの色で染めているかが相手に判るまで時間がかかる分若干仕掛けやすくなるというメリットが一応ある。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"id":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0101","type":"text","tag":"p","paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0036","text":"例：","segments":[{"text":"例：","marks":["span::bold"],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"id":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0102","type":"image-run","paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0036","images":[{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00183","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:c2e1bc47e16951c65ef2acaa","title":"六萬","alt":"六"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00184","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:947ac9e4290a3efde47c8a0e","title":"二索","alt":"２"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00185","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:efde650fe35a084958cfb03f","title":"三索","alt":"３"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00186","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:e55f2661c108fb3854242c3f","title":"五索","alt":"５"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00187","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:67422e7f1a2aaedf226710e6","title":"七索","alt":"７"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00188","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:865231b0b04f914254e01fc9","title":"八索","alt":"８"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00189","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:980a15d32d9378aab6e30fb4","title":"東","alt":"東"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00190","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:980a15d32d9378aab6e30fb4","title":"東","alt":"東"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00191","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:980a15d32d9378aab6e30fb4","title":"東","alt":"東"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00192","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:b1129ff7c5cc68acdf0cdd67","title":"西","alt":"西"},{"occurrenceId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:i00193","assetId":"modern-yabejp-ja:b1129ff7c5cc68acdf0cdd67","title":"西","alt":"西"}],"tableContext":null},{"id": 「","marks":[],"href":null},{"text":"多面張理論（メンチンの革命編）","marks":[],"href":"http://ameblo.jp/010101/entry-10035459441.html"},{"text":"」の内容を参照されたい。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null}],"tables":[]},"candidate":{"title":"染手（混一色、清一色）","blocks":[{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0001"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0001","text":"染手（混一色、清一色）","sourceSegments":[{"text":"一色手（混一色･清一色）","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0002"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0002","text":"即使副露也有望获得高打点，因此性价比很高，也经常会从离听牌还很远的阶段强行做染手。正因如此，很多局面都难以判断是否应该以染手为目标。这次就尝试为这种难以判断的染手选择，设立尽可能明确的判断标准。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"鳴いても高打点が見込めるのでコストパフォーマンスが良く、テンパイに遠いところから強引に染めていくこともしばしばある。その為、一色手を狙うかどうかの判断が難しい局面も多々ある。今回は、その判断が難しい染め手狙いについて、できるだけ明確な判断基準を設けることを試みる。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0040"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0019","text":"考虑满足条件A、B时的强度","sourceSegments":[{"text":"条件A、Bを満たした場合の強さを考慮する","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0041"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0020","text":"简单来说，就是比较做成染手和做成其他面子手时的打点。如果有2组役牌对子（或1组役牌对子＋仍有剩余的字牌2～3种），或宝牌属于目标花色或字牌，就很容易做成满贯级别的手牌，因此更适合积极地做染手。尤其是有2组役牌对子的手牌，希望尽可能通过混一色、对对和、宝牌等做成满贯级别的手牌。另一方面，如果不做染手也有望达到满贯级别，或其他花色中有宝牌或赤宝牌，就不必勉强保留孤立字牌，以役牌＋α为主线，摸牌顺利时再做染手即可。在选择是否保留孤立役牌时，如果该役牌成对后仍有转向混一色的可能，也就是有可能满足条件A，那么保留役牌就更有利。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"簡単に言えば一色手になった場合と他の面子手になった場合の打点の比較である。役牌トイツが２組（もしくは役牌トイツ１組＋生きている字牌２〜３種）あったり、ドラが染め色や字牌であれば容易に満貫クラスの手になるので尚積極的に染める方が良くなる。特に役牌トイツ２組の手はなるだけホンイツやトイトイ、ドラ等で満貫クラスの手に仕上げたい。一方、染めなくても満貫クラスが見込めるような手や他色にドラや赤がある手であれば無理に孤立字牌を残したりせず、役牌＋αを本線にしつつツモが良ければ染める程度でよい。孤立役牌を残すかどうかを選択する場合も、孤立役牌が重なることでホンイツに移行する可能性が残る、即ち条件Aを満たしうる可能性が出てくるときは尚役牌残しが良くなる。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0042"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0021","text":"西家　第2巡","sourceSegments":[{"text":"西家　２巡目","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0043"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0021","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0043:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0044"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0021","text":"　→切","sourceSegments":[{"text":"　→打","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0045"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0021","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0045:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0046"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0021","text":"或","sourceSegments":[{"text":"か","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0047"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0021","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0047:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0048"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0022","text":"基本上以混一色为目标副露推进。毕竟也有对对和的可能，所以切","sourceSegments":[{"text":"ほぼホンイツで仕掛けていく。一応トイトイもあるので打","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0049"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0022","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0049:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0050"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0022","text":"或切","sourceSegments":[{"text":"か打","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0051"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0022","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0051:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0052"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0022","text":"。大多只能做成仅有混一色这一役的手牌，但其他和牌途径都很困难，所以也没有办法。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"。ほとんどホンイツのみどまりの手になるが、他に和了する方法が難しいのでやむをえない。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0053"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0023","text":"第4巡","sourceSegments":[{"text":"４巡目","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0054"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0023","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0054:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0055"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0023","text":"　→拆掉万子的两嵌","sourceSegments":[{"text":"　→マンズのリャンカン払い","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0056"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0024","text":"筒子或字牌只要形成搭子（对子），就能满足条件A，而且从速度和打点来看，混一色也更有利。现在就先于字牌拆掉万子的两嵌。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"ピンズか字牌でターツ（トイツ）が出来れば条件Aを満たすし、速度や打点面でもホンイツ有利。字牌より先にもうマンズのリャンカンを払っていく。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0057"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0025","text":"第6巡","sourceSegments":[{"text":"６巡目","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0058"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0025","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja s":[{"text":"　→打","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0085"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0031","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0085:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0086"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0032","text":"若只考虑组成面子的难易程度，","sourceSegments":[{"text":"面子構成しやすさだけを考えれば","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0087"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0032","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0087:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0088"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0032","text":"或","sourceSegments":[{"text":"や","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0089"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0032","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0089:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0090"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0032","text":"最不需要，但应保留索子混一色或一气通贯的可能性，切","sourceSegments":[{"text":"が一番不要だが、ソーズのホンイツやイッツー目は残して打","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0091"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0032","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0091:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0092"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0032","text":"。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0093"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0033","text":"第2巡","sourceSegments":[{"text":"２巡目","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0094"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0033","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0094:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0095"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0033","text":"　→切","sourceSegments":[{"text":"　→打","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0096"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0033","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0096:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0097"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0034","text":"目标花色的面子候选已经齐备，有望达到满贯。也考虑到对对和、白、中组成的满贯，","sourceSegments":[{"text":"染め色の面子候補は揃っており満貫が見込める。トイトイ白中の満貫もみて","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0098"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0034","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0098:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0099"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0034","text":"的拆除或许是有力的选择。巡目变深后，如果手牌没有发展，也时常会最终只做成1,000点或2,000点的手牌，但这样也可以。应避免不顾巡目和其他家的进展，执意勉强做染手。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"落しが有力か。巡目が深くなって手が伸びなければ1,000点や2,000点の手に終わってしまうこともままあるがそれはそれでよい。巡目や他家の進行状況を顧みずに無理染めに固執することは避けたい。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0100"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0035","text":"染手是强力的役种，但有容易被对手看穿意图的缺点。不过，这一点不必太在意。因为很少有其他更好的打法能让自己不被警戒地和出高分手牌，而在手牌较差时以染手为目标，让对手产生警戒，反而可能成为优点。不过，也有面子候选已经足够，即使是目标花色或字牌，也会出现不需要的孤立牌的情况。先切出这类牌，掩饰自己正在做染手的意图，是有效的做法。另外，决定专做混一色时，先从数量第二多的花色开始切，能让对手花更长时间才判断出自己在染哪种花色，因此多少也有稍微更容易副露的优点。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"一色手は強力な手役だが相手に狙いを読まれやすいというデメリットがある。しかしこれについてはあまり気にしなくて良い。警戒されずに高い手を和了できるより良い手順が他にあることは滅多に無く、手が悪い時に染め手を狙って相手に警戒させるのは寧ろメリットになりうるからである。但し、既に面子候補が足りていて染め色や字牌でも不要な孤立牌が出てくる場合もある。このような牌は先に切り出して染め手を狙っていることをカモフラージュするのが有効である。また、ホンイツに決め打ちする場合、二番目に多い色から切っていく方がどの色で染めているかが相手に判るまで時間がかかる分若干仕掛けやすくなるというメリットが一応ある。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0101"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0036","text":"**例：**","sourceSegments":[{"text":"例：","marks":["span::bold"],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0102"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0036","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0102:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0103"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0036","text":"　碰","sourceSegments":[{"text":"　ポン","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0104"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0036","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0104:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0105"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0036","text":"　→切","sourceSegments":[{"text":"　→打","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"figure","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0106"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0036","figureId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0106:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:b0107"],"paragraphId":"modern-yabejp-ja:chapter01-section035:p0037","text":"染手（尤其是门前清的清一色）容易形成多面听。关于快速看出多面听的方法，请参阅[牌效率论20](http://yabejp.web.fc2.com/mahjong/tactics/chapter01/section020.html)中介
